packageRules.description: Hold react-day-picker on v9: v10 removed ClassNames keys (e.g. `table`) that the shadcn Calendar component still uses. Revisit when the shadcn calendar supports v10.

Hold pnpm on v10: Vercel ignores packageManager (uses pnpm 9), so a major bump has no production effect, and pnpm 11's default minimumReleaseAge policy blocks installs of freshly published deps. Revisit if Vercel adopts corepack.
